title_en: Guiding Case No. 242: Chongqing Mouguang Real Estate Brokerage Co., Ltd. v. Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau, Jiulongpo District Branch — application for compensation for criminal illegal seizure
ruling_gist_en: During the handling of criminal cases, if judicial authorities, for the purpose of preserving seized or detained property, illegally occupy immovable property of a compensation claimant that is unrelated to the criminal case and cause economic losses to the claimant, this falls under the circumstance provided in Article 18, Item 1 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China. Where a compensation claimant applies for state compensation on this basis, the people's court shall support it according to law.

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 242

Chongqing Mouguang Real Estate Brokerage Co., Ltd. v. Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch — Compensation for Unlawful Seizure in Criminal Proceedings

(Deliberated and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, published on December 23, 2024)

**Keywords**
State compensation / Compensation for unlawful seizure in criminal proceedings / Custody measures / Occupation of real property

**Ruling Gist**

Where, in the course of handling a criminal case, a judicial authority unlawfully occupies the immovable property of a claimant for compensation who is unrelated to the criminal case in order to store seized or confiscated property, thereby causing economic loss, this falls within the circumstances specified in Article 18(1) of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China. If the claimant applies for state compensation on that basis, the People's Court shall grant compensation in accordance with law.

**Basic Facts**

On July 1, 2011, Chongqing Mouguang Real Estate Brokerage Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Chongqing Mouguang Company") and Chongqing Moucheng Housing Sales Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Chongqing Moucheng Company"), as lessors, leased the negative first floor (street level) of a commercial building in Jiulongpo District, Chongqing, to Chongqing Moulimaoye Automobile Leasing Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Mouli Automobile Leasing Company"), and the first floor (second street level) to Guangdong Moujia Health Industry Supermarket Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Moujia Health Company"). The two lessee companies paid rent up to July 15, 2012.

Because Mouli Automobile Leasing Company and Moujia Health Company were suspected of illegally absorbing public deposits, the Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch decided on May 15, 2012, to open a criminal investigation and seized on-site the items and vehicles involved in the case located in the leased commercial premises. Subsequently, as the premises leased by Mouli Automobile Leasing Company and Moujia Health Company needed to be vacated, starting from May 22, 2013, the Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch transferred the seized items and vehicles to parking spaces owned by Chongqing Mouguang Company and Chongqing Moucheng Company for storage, until September 30, 2017.

Later, Chongqing Mouguang Company and Chongqing Moucheng Company applied to the Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch for state compensation for their losses in rent, property management fees, parking space rental, and utility costs. During the process, after negotiation and agreement between the two companies, the right to claim such losses was exclusively vested in Chongqing Mouguang Company. The Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch issued Criminal Compensation Decision No. 2 (2017) (Jiu Gong Xing Pei Zi [2017] No. 2), deciding not to compensate Chongqing Mouguang Company. Dissatisfied, Chongqing Mouguang Company applied for reconsideration to the Chongqing Public Security Bureau. The Chongqing Public Security Bureau issued Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision No. 36 (2017) (Yu Gong Pei Fu Jue Zi [2017] No. 36), upholding the original decision. Subsequently, Chongqing Mouguang Company applied to the Compensation Committee of the Chongqing Fifth Intermediate People's Court for a compensation decision.

**Judgment**

The Compensation Committee of the Chongqing Fifth Intermediate People's Court, on October 24, 2018, issued State Compensation Decision No. 12 (2018) (Yu 05 Wei Pei 12 [2018]), deciding as follows:

1. The Criminal Compensation Decision No. 2 (2017) (Jiu Gong Xing Pei Zi [2017] No. 2) of the Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch and the Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision No. 36 (2017) (Yu Gong Pei Fu Jue Zi [2017] No. 36) of the Chongqing Public Security Bureau are revoked.
2. The Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch shall, within thirty days after this decision takes effect, pay compensation of RMB 1,083,300 to Chongqing Mouguang Company.

**Reasoning**

Article 18 of the State Compensation Law provides: "Where an organ exercising the functions of investigation, prosecution, or adjudication, or a detention center, prison administration organ, or their staff members, while exercising their functions, commit any of the following acts infringing upon property rights, the victim has the right to obtain compensation: (1) unlawfully taking measures such as sealing up, seizing, freezing, or recovering property..." Article 3 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases (Fa Shi [2015] No. 24) provides: "After measures such as sealing up, seizing, freezing, or recovering property have been taken, where any of the following circumstances exist, and the case-handling organ has not lifted the measures of sealing up, seizing, freezing, etc., or returned the property in accordance with law, it shall be regarded as an infringement of property rights under Article 18 of the State Compensation Law: (1) the claimant has evidence proving that the property is unrelated to the criminal case that has not been concluded, and upon examination, the evidence is found to be true..." In this case, after deciding to investigate Mouli Automobile Leasing Company and Moujia Health Company, the Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch seized on-site the items and vehicles involved in the case located in the leased commercial premises and, after the leases expired, continued to store them in the commercial premises and parking spaces belonging to Chongqing Mouguang Company. Although the Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch did not seal up the aforesaid immovable property of Chongqing Mouguang Company, it objectively occupied such property and, having determined that Chongqing Mouguang Company was unrelated to the criminal case involved, failed to return the property to Chongqing Mouguang Company in a timely manner. The aforesaid acts caused economic losses to Chongqing Mouguang Company and infringed upon its property rights. Therefore, the Chongqing Public Security Bureau Jiulongpo District Branch shall bear state compensation liability.

**Related Provisions**

Article 18 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China

Article 3 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases (Fa Shi [2015] No. 24)
